Tom — thanks for the redline and the clear list. I’ve routed this to our privacy counsel and ops; please find our counsel responses attached (Redwood_Counsel_Responses_v1.pdf) and a snapshot of our subprocessor inventory (redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20281201.csv). High-level responses below: 

1) Data residency / carveout
- We can support a US-only deployment for your production tenancy. That is an operational configuration request rather than a permanent contractual broad carveout. Counsel suggests the below compromise language: Redwood will not export or transfer Acme production customer content outside of the US except with Acme’s prior written consent or as required by law; Redwood will provide reasonable documentation of any required transfer.
- If Acme requires the additional contractual lock (explicit clause), we are open to a short carveout addendum limited to the customer’s production OWNR tenancy — we’d need to scope it to avoid global product restrictions.

2) Subprocessor evidence
- Attached CSV contains current subprocessors and the attestation status (SOC2 report available / ISO / in-progress). For subprocessors with in-progress reports, we can provide a remediation timeline and interim controls. Marcus — can you confirm the SOC2 copy availability for the two infra providers flagged on the inventory?

3) Cross-border transfers
- For EU-origin data, Redwood uses the SCCs where applicable; for customers who require a bespoke EU-US transfer addendum we can route the EU-US addendum. Jonas — can you confirm which model versions and control plane flows would be impacted by the EU-US addendum from an engineering routing perspective?

4) Esign path
- DocuSign is fine. We typically execute with the customer signing first and Redwood countersigning; if Acme needs a specific signing order we can accommodate. I will prepare a clean execution copy and send via DocuSign once we agree language on the few outstanding items.

Next steps proposed:
- Marcus: confirm SOC2 artifacts/status (by EOD 12/01)
- Jonas: brief note on transfer impact and whether we need a technical appendix (by 12/02)
- Lauren: prepare the execution Docusign envelope (clean DPA + addendum placeholders) once counsel confirms final language (target 12/02)

Tom / Megan — if that plan works I’ll send the DocuSign envelope after we get Marcus’s confirmation.

Thanks,
